language: one or more arbitrary bytes followed by EOS

upstream_grammar.byte_mapping: each exact byte is mapped bijectively to the same-code-point Latin-1 character

token_generator.ids_0_through_255: one byte equal to the token id
token_generator.ids_256_and_above: 0xA5 followed by the token id as unsigned little-endian 32-bit
token_generator.eos: the final token id, represented by an empty manifest entry

operations.compile_prepare: Python facade through PyO3 source compilation and preparation; manifest construction excluded
operations.compile_prepare_peak_rss: peak resident set size in a clean child process after one source compilation and preparation
operations.engine_initial_mask: candidate NativeBatch.initial_masks or frozen-upstream initial CFGMonitor acceptance
operations.engine_advance_and_mask: candidate NativeBatch.advance_and_masks or frozen-upstream CFGMonitor feed_token plus acceptance for one row
operations.processor_advance_and_mask: trusted fixed-append GreatGrammaLogitsProcessor call with a dependency-free no-op masker that reads the packed buffer
